name: @acme/docs
description: The project's documentation site: pages and a DocsConfig; stackra gen assembles the Mintlify site into .stackra/site, with the API reference from the consumed services' manifests.

scripts.clean: node -e "for (const p of process.argv.slice(1)) process.getBuiltinModule('node:fs').rmSync(p, { recursive: true, force: true })" .stackra/site .turbo
